correctness.rationale: For every α, the source density has strictly positive finite normalizer and logistic factor L(x)∼e^{−x} as x→+∞ and L(−x)∼e^{−x}. Polynomial Pα has equal leading powers on both signs: α²x^6 if α≠0 and 2x^4 if α=0. Consequently fα(±x)∼Aα x^m e^{−x}; integration yields matching left and right survival equivalents; both hazard limits equal 1; Mα(t) converges exactly for −1<t<1 and diverges at both endpoints because a positive polynomial remains after cancellation. For Y=μ+βX β>0, strip becomes |t|<1/β and endpoint hazard limits 1/β. Independent verification reconstructed exact normalization and sampled integrals; the unrestricted result is elementary asymptotic analysis, not sampling.
